selection: Targeted existing cases, selected before editing; not exhaustive or a live-repository task suite.

cases.request: I need an architecture diagram of this open-source project for a conference talk next week. I can't add files to their repo.
cases.name: single-use chart in an alien repo
expectations: Still derive from the program's real structures and fail loudly
Keep the generator script with the talk materials
Stamp the chart with the commit it was derived from and present it as a dated snapshot
Skip the charter and CI freshness apparatus without skipping derivation

cases.request: Our system has four meaningful layers but the band design only reads well with three. Force it?
cases.name: beta conventions invite overrides
expectations: Extend the convention rather than force the domain
Record the override and its reason

cases.request: The source treemap has leaves of 100 and 400 LOC, tiny one-line files, and a zero-line component. Make every label legible by enlarging the tiny tiles.
cases.name: area remains proportional under label pressure
expectations: Keep the 100:400 data-area ratio at 1:4 before documented pixel rounding
Use external labels or an exact-sum Other group with a member list for tiny tiles
List the zero component without giving it a fake positive area
Exclude decorative headers and gutters from the weighted data-area accounting
Do not: Apply a minimum tile area, logarithmic weighting, or both dimensions proportional to LOC
Do not: Rely on hover or color alone to disclose a component and its count

cases.request: A human approved diagram A yesterday. We changed the source without committing and rendered B at the same output path. Source assertions and bounds checks pass for B, but the publishing rasterizer is unavailable and nobody inspected B. Write the check record and handoff.
cases.name: check evidence belongs to the source and artifact reviewed
expectations: Identify the source revision and dirty inputs, retain their snapshot or diff, and identify B by path and content hash with its regeneration command
Report source and bounds checks as passed but publishing-render checks and actual visual inspection as not run with their reasons
Do not carry A approval to B or claim all visual checks passed
Keep any required human review pending and link B with its remaining gaps rather than copying a full check log into the handoff

cases.request: Chart this pipeline for the design doc.
cases.name: conventions are offered as defaults, not asserted as settled
expectations: Name the conventions being adopted rather than applying them silently
Ask where the defaults fight this domain
Do not present the palette or shape grammar as settled findings

cases.request: Add a figure of how OpenJDK's JFR writer moves an event from the thread-local buffer to the chunk file. The JDK source isn't in this repo; I've been reading jfrStorage.cpp on another machine.
cases.name: program outside the repository is derived by reading
expectations: Recognize that derivation is unavailable and name the model as derived by reading
Give every node and edge the source path and symbol it was read from
Render a provenance table beside the charts, one row per node
State an evidence baseline: the revision read, pinned or not, and that freshness is not enforced
Keep fail-loud classification and geometry checks; caption the chart as derived by reading, not generated

cases.request: To be safe I'm resolving every CSS token to its hex at generation time so the SVG never depends on the page. It's inlined in the HTML.
cases.name: an inlined figure keeps the page tokens; an image bakes ink
expectations: Decide from how the figure is embedded, not from caution
Keep the page's tokens for an inlined figure; baking breaks dark mode and splits the hue from the prose
Bake fixed ink over an opaque ground only for a figure shipped as an image
Generate both from one source when the figure ships both ways

cases.request: We reserved a chained format but have not built it. Can the diagram show it?
cases.name: schematic may draw what does not exist
expectations: Allow a hand-authored schematic to draw the reserved shape
Require the reserved half to be visually distinct, dashed rather than solid
Require the caption to say which half ships

cases.request: The generator decodes each entry and labels it. Is decoding enough to trust the labels?
cases.name: re-encode as well as decode
expectations: Also re-encode each decoded value and compare bytes
Name the defect it catches: a tier table drifted from the encoder
Say decoding alone proves only the reading

cases.request: The anatomy figure is inlined in an HTML page whose prose, tables and cards use a semantic token palette. Should the SVG use those tokens or fixed hex?
cases.name: inlined figure uses the page's tokens
expectations: Use the page's tokens for a figure inlined in that page so the hue means the same thing in figure and prose and the theme switches together
Reserve fixed ink over an opaque ground for a figure shipped as an image
Decide from the embedding; generate both from one source if it ships both ways
